versions.name: Camp Sawyer
versions.address: 33990 Overseas Highway, Big Pine Key, FL 33043
versions.summary: A South Florida Council beachfront camp on Scout Key in the lower Florida Keys, part of the Edward B. Knight Scout Reservation, with oceanfront tent campsites for units drawn to swimming, snorkeling, and boating.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified from the South Florida Council's own Camp Sawyer page, which describes it as the council's currently operating beachfront camp on Scout Key at the Edward B. Knight Scout Reservation. The source's council website (sfcbsa.org) resolves to the current sfcscouting.org domain. Coordinates geocoded via US Census; elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add: existence, council, and operating status verified against the council's own camp page; camp_type/program_types classified conservatively as a beachfront tent-camping property; features unsurveyed.
